supplied_and_used.role: The hillside: the left of the one scene. The cover, Ch. 1 and the four scenes that follow it.
supplied_and_used.shows: Three women tend a towering golden dandelion on a hillside above the sea: one kneels over a map, one looks up at the seed head, one ties a timber support to the stem. Roots in red earth, thatched houses, mountains, the sea.
supplied_and_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_and_used.role: The table: the middle of the one scene, joined to the hillside at its left-hand sandstone pillar. The clear plan, the terms, the partners and the resources.
supplied_and_used.shows: Two women, a schoolgirl with a slate and a young woman with folded cloth at a timber table around a map held down by river stones, with a compass and a small potted dandelion. A man reaches for a book on cedar shelves; a brass scale and a ruler sit on a shelf; arches open onto the sea and two dhows. A sandstone pillar fills the left edge.
supplied_and_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_and_used.role: The veranda at dusk: the right of the one scene, joined to the table at the cedar posts. The approach, about, the brief, the questions and the closing.
supplied_and_used.shows: An empty stone veranda at dusk: folded cloth on a dark ledge, arches over palms and the sea, two dhows, a lit brass lantern and one dandelion seed on the wall.
supplied_and_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_not_used.shows: Two women plant a dandelion seed in a terracotta bowl. The far-left background is a hill town with a dome, an aqueduct and cypress trees, which reads as Italian.
supplied_not_used.why_not: Its edges cannot meet the others: neither side has an upright where a join could fall, and its far-left background reads as an Italian hill town. It is kept in the repository as the reference for a joinable remake (Prompt S, Part 5.3). Not needed on the live site.
supplied_not_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_not_used.name: Veranda panorama
supplied_not_used.shows: A wide veranda: five women at a map table, a carved pillar, shelves with botanical prints, a bench with a brass scale, a slate, a balustrade, a palm, the sea at dusk and a lantern.
supplied_not_used.why_not: It is 667 pixels tall, its edges cannot meet the other paintings, it repeats scenes they already carry, and its figures are a different cast. Not stored in this folder.

made_for_this_site.what: A lighter copy of each painting, 1100 x 619 pixels, WebP quality 72, resized from the supplied file. Browsers choose it for small, low-density windows. The planting copy is kept with its original and not used.

Drawn on top of the paintings, never into them: seeds that leave the seed head and come down on the map, motes of dust in the indoor light, a few seeds crossing the evening sky, a soft glow at the lantern, three numbered gold discs, a gold ring, a gold box around a shelf. A few small places in the paintings stir by a pixel or two (the seed head sways, open water shimmers, the boats ride a slow swell) by displacing the picture, never repainting it.
